claims.summary: I have not changed the coordinator or written a commit record yet, because the approved batch definitions conflict with each other. edge-cutover's current revision 2 needs maint=1 and cache=3 at the same time. Only cache-reindex writes cache=3, and it requires maint=0 and worker=8. worker-v8 needs schema=5, which schema-v5 can write only while maint=1. So cache-reindex can only run after maint-enter and after maint-exit, and maint-enter is the only operation that sets maint to 1, once. After the reindex, maintenance can never be on again, so edge-cutover's check can never pass in any order, with or without retries. Can netops re-approve edge-cutover without maint=1, can the reindex be approved during maintenance, or can the cutover move to a separate batch? Once one of those is decided I can implement the scheduler and deliver the complete record.
